name: Search for an Excess of Electron Neutrino Interactions in MicroBooNE Using Multiple Final State Topologies
notes: This 2021 multi-topology search targets the MiniBooNE low-energy excess (result:miniboone-low-energy-excess-2021) and found no corresponding excess of electron-neutrino events; the paper states that the MiniBooNE excess remains unexplained.

significance.locator: arXiv:2110.14054, abstract (no significance/sigma reported for a null result)
significance.note: This is a null/consistency result across three independent analyses; the abstract reports consistency with background rather than a single sigma value.

summary.plain: MicroBooNE searched for the low-energy excess of events that MiniBooNE reported, using a liquid-argon imaging detector that the paper says distinguishes electron-induced from photon-induced showers much better than MiniBooNE's detector. Three independent electron-neutrino searches all found rates consistent with the nominal expectation, and no excess of electron-neutrino events.
summary.technical: Three independent νe searches in the Booster Neutrino Beam (an exclusive search for two-body CCQE scattering, a semi-inclusive search for pionless events and an inclusive search): results consistent with the nominal νe rate expectations and no excess of νe events observed. The paper says this picture appears to disfavor an interpretation of MiniBooNE's excess as arising purely from an anomalously high rate of charged-current νe interactions, rejects the hypothesis that νe CC interactions are fully responsible for the excess at >97% CL for the exclusive and inclusive event classes, and says the MiniBooNE excess remains unexplained.

title: Search for an Excess of Electron Neutrino Interactions in MicroBooNE Using Multiple Final State Topologies
why_it_matters: The paper says the multi-pronged search is aimed at investigating the as-yet unexplained low energy excess of electromagnetic activity observed by MiniBooNE. It concludes that its sensitive measurements are so far inconsistent with an electron-neutrino interpretation of the excess, while the excess itself remains unexplained.
